title: 卡尔萨斯·小小八音盒
description: 卡尔萨斯保留高冠长袍与苍白面部轮廓，温和低头听八音盒，长杖静立一旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Karthus is a tall spectral robed figure with a pale skull-like mask face, a high pointed crown, long dark blue-violet robes, and a softly glowing staff. Preserve the recognizable lich silhouette but simplify the face into friendly theatrical ivory shapes, without exposed decay or frightening teeth. All body areas remain covered by opaque layered cloth, and the staff rests securely beside his seat.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small stone table and listens to a little open music box with a simple turning star shape, one hand resting gently beside it. A pale curtain and a round lamp soften the room. Keep his head inclined with quiet curiosity, the staff still, and the atmosphere cozy rather than ghostly or mournful.
art_direction.palette: indigo robe, pale ivory, mist blue, warm gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
